headline: President Clinton set up a commission to study how workers and communities are affected by changes in the economy.
what_it_does: This executive order created a Commission on Workers, Communities, and Economic Change in the New Economy. Based on the title, the commission's job was to look at how economic changes affect workers and the places they live. No summary was provided, so details about its members, duties, or deadlines are not known from this source.

who_it_affects.how: Their experiences with economic change were the subject the commission was set up to study.
Communities affected by economic change were part of what the commission was asked to look at.
